header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH,
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
body: None is present on behalf of the petitioner nor any intimation is received. This petition was filed with prayer that respondents No.2 to 4 be directed to change the Fotikhatabadal of the agricultural land of the petitioner. Learned A.A.G appearing in some other cases waives notice and submits that if the petitioner approaches the District Redressal Committee, constituted by the Government of Sindh, his grievance will be redressed.
In view of the above, this petition is disposed of. Copy of this order be communicated to the learned A.A.G for compliance.
